description: Retrieves a noise-reduced accessibility tree as the default page perception entry for locating interactive targets and canonical ids; do not use it when you specifically need raw DOM tag hierarchy or attributes.

pageId.description: Page ID whose accessibility tree should be returned.

purpose.description: Describe why you need accessibility semantics, e.g., locating a clickable target, checking enabled/checked state, or refreshing canonical element ids
